mapper.subject: [URGENT] Lead Capture Failed - Manual Entry Required

contents.text:
🚨 Action Required: Lead Capture Failed

A new lead just filled out your form, but our system couldn't save it to your Notion CRM due to a connection or database issue.

1. Save Your Lead (Manual Entry)

Please manually add this person to your Notion Clients database right now so you don't lose the prospect:

Name {{1.name}}
Email {{1.email}}

2. How to Fix This Issue (Safely)

Please look at the System Error Detail at the very bottom of this email. Find your error type below and follow the exact steps to fix it without touching any complex code:

🔴 If it says "Validation Error" or "Missing Property":

Cause: You accidentally renamed, deleted, or changed the property type of a critical column in your Notion Clients database.

How to fix (No coding required):

  1. Go to your Clients database in Notion.
  2. Check if you recently renamed or deleted any columns. (Remember the rule: Never rename or delete columns that have a 🔒 emoji).
  3. Simply rename the column back to its original name, or restore the deleted column from your Notion trash.
  4. Click here to view the original Database Schema Guide to see exactly how your columns should be named.

🔴 If it says "Unauthorized" or "Invalid Connection":

Cause: Make.com lost permission to access your Notion account (usually happens if you change your Notion password).

How to fix (Safe method):

  1. Log in to Make.com.
  2. Look at the dark sidebar on the left of your screen (Do not open any scenarios).
  3. Click on Credentials (the Shield icon 🛡).
  4. Find your Notion connection in the list.
  5. Click the Reauthorize button next to it. (Do not click Verify).
  6. A Notion window will pop up. Follow the prompts to grant access again. That's it!

🔴 If it says "Timeout" or "500/502 Error":

Cause: Notion's servers are temporarily down.

How to fix: You don't need to do anything. Your setup is perfectly fine. Just add this lead manually for now; the system will recover automatically when Notion is back online.

System Error Detail:

fields.title: Webhook Warning - Invalid Token {{1.email}}
fields.%3A%3DML: Check the webhook URL in your external tool (Typeform, Calendly, etc.). Ensure the "?token=" parameter exactly matches the Webhook Secret Token in your System Settings. If you didn't set up a new form recently, this was a spam bot. No action is needed.
